job.title: Software Development Engineer
job.pay_full: $121,600 – $180,600 a year base salary (Newark, NJ), plus sign-on payments and restricted stock units

details.about: Audible produces and shares audio storytelling with millions of listeners around the world. As a Software Development Engineer you help define, design and refine the technology behind it, building and maintaining the platform that brings thousands of stories to millions of listeners. The role is posted by Audible, Inc. on amazon.jobs.
duties: Develop, test and maintain software components and applications for the world's largest audiobook creator and provider
Find and fix defects through code review, log analysis, metrics, debugging and other troubleshooting
Write maintainable, scalable code as part of an agile engineering team
Work with stakeholders to design, build, test and launch customer-centric software
Improve testability, operational excellence and documentation for the components you own
Handle data classification, storage and management according to company policy
Take part in interviews and mentor fellow engineers
needs: Experience with at least one modern language such as Java, Python, C++ or C#, including object-oriented design
Experience with data structures, basic algorithm development and/or object-oriented design principles
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a closely related field
nice: Optimization mathematics such as linear and nonlinear programming
Distributed, multi-tiered systems, algorithms and relational databases
Technical internships or demonstrated project experience
Cloud platforms (preferably AWS), SQL and NoSQL databases, AI tools for development productivity, open-source contributions or version control
details.benefits: Base salary $121,600 – $180,600 a year in Newark, NJ. The package includes sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs); final pay depends on experience, qualifications and location. Benefits include medical, dental, vision and prescription cover, life and AD&D insurance, mental health support, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, 401(k) matching, paid time off and parental leave.
notes: Workplace accommodations are available during the hiring process for candidates with disabilities
